functions.name: agent_spend
functions.doc:
Sends `amount` from `owner_id`'s vault to `receiver_id`. Only the vault's registered agent
 may call this, and only within the vault's policy. The balance is deducted and the spend
 recorded before the transfer is created; `on_spend_complete` reverses both if it fails.

functions.name: agent_swap
functions.doc:
Swaps `amount_in` of `token_in` from `owner_id`'s vault for `token_out` through exchange
 pool `pool_id`. Only the vault's registered agent may call this, and only within the
 vault's policy; it needs at least `AGENT_SWAP_TGAS` of gas.

 This call checks the policy and asks the exchange for a quote (`get_return`); it changes no
 state. `on_swap_quoted` checks the policy again against the state at that point, rejects a
 `min_amount_out` further below the quote than the pool's `max_slippage_bps`, and only then
 deducts token_in and records the swap. The chain then deposits token_in into the vault's
 exchange account, swaps it there (learning the exact output from the exchange's return
 value), and withdraws the output to the vault, crediting the owner exactly that amount. If
 the deposit or swap fails, token_in is refunded and the record removed.

functions.name: deposit
functions.doc: Credits the attached NEAR to the caller's vault, creating the vault on first deposit.

functions.name: freeze
functions.doc:
Blocks all agent spending and swapping from the caller's vault, starting with the next
 agent call. Deliberately needs no deposit, so any key on the owner's account can hit the brakes.

functions.name: ft_on_transfer
functions.doc:
NEP-141 receiver: credits tokens sent with `ft_transfer_call` to the sender's vault. The
 token must be in the sender's policy and `msg` must be empty; otherwise this panics and
 the token contract refunds the transfer.

functions.name: lock_withdrawals_until
functions.doc:
Blocks `withdraw`, `withdraw_token` and `set_agent` for the caller's vault until block
 timestamp `timestamp_ns`; from that timestamp on they work again. A lock can only be
 extended: a value earlier than the current lock is rejected, even if that lock has already
 expired.

 Nothing else changes: `remove_agent`, `freeze` and `unfreeze` work as before, and the
 current agent can still spend and swap within its current policy while withdrawals are
 locked. Requires exactly 1 yoctoNEAR (full-access key only). The first lock's storage is
 charged to the vault balance.

functions.name: new
functions.doc:
`exchange_id` is the exchange every swap goes through; `treasury_id` is the only account
 that can withdraw the swap fees. Neither can be changed afterwards.

functions.name: on_reclaim_checked
functions.doc:
Reclaim step 2: the exchange reported how much of `token_id` the vault's account holds.
 Withdraws the owner's own `on_exchange` amount only if that covers everything the ledger
 says owners are owed and nothing moved since `reclaim_from_exchange` read `generation`.
 Every refusal panics before changing anything; a shortfall also logs `exchange_shortfall`.

functions.name: on_swap_deposited
functions.doc:
Swap step 2: token_in's `ft_transfer_call` into the vault's exchange account resolved to
 the amount the exchange kept. All of it: swap it. None: the token refunded it, so refund
 the owner.

functions.name: on_swap_executed
functions.doc:
Swap step 3: the exchange's `swap` returned the exact amount out, or failed (for example
 below `min_amount_out`) and left token_in in the vault's exchange account.

functions.name: on_swap_output_withdrawn
functions.doc:
Swap step 4: the output's withdrawal from the exchange resolved to `amount_out` if it
 reached the vault. Then the owner is credited `amount_out` less the protocol fee, and the
 treasury the fee: together exactly `amount_out`. If it did not arrive, the whole amount is
 recorded as the owner's, left on the exchange, with no fee.

functions.name: on_swap_quoted
functions.doc:
Swap step 1: the exchange quoted the swap, or failed to. Nothing has been deducted yet, so
 every rejection here simply panics and leaves the vault as it was. The policy is checked
 again because the owner or another agent call may have changed the vault since
 `agent_swap`.

functions.name: reclaim_from_exchange
functions.doc:
Retries withdrawing the caller's `token_id` left in the vault's exchange account after an
 earlier withdrawal from the exchange failed. Works while frozen and while withdrawals are
 locked (the tokens stay in the vault). Requires exactly 1 yoctoNEAR (full-access key only)
 and at least `RECLAIM_TGAS` of gas.

 Every owner's tokens on the exchange share the vault's one account there, so this first
 asks the exchange how much of `token_id` that account holds (`get_deposit`).
 `on_reclaim_checked` withdraws the caller's own `on_exchange` amount only if the account
 holds at least what the ledger says all owners are owed, and only if no swap or reclaim of
 `token_id` started in the meantime. Otherwise it refuses and changes nothing.

functions.name: remove_agent
functions.doc:
Clears the caller's agent and policy. Requires exactly 1 yoctoNEAR (full-access key only).

 Leaves the frozen flag, token balances and the record of recent spends unchanged, so a
 newly registered agent still sees the last 24 hours of spending.

functions.name: set_agent
functions.doc:
Registers (or replaces) the caller's agent and policy. Requires exactly 1 yoctoNEAR so it
 can only be signed with a full-access key, never a function-call key handed to an app or agent.

 Rejected while the caller's withdrawals are locked: a new agent or policy would be a way
 around the lock. `remove_agent`, `freeze` and `unfreeze` still work.

 Leaves the frozen flag, token balances and the record of recent spends unchanged.

functions.name: unfreeze
functions.doc: Re-enables agent spending and swapping. Requires exactly 1 yoctoNEAR (full-access key only).

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc:
Sends `amount` from the caller's vault back to the caller. Works while frozen, but not
 while withdrawals are locked. Requires exactly 1 yoctoNEAR (full-access key only).

functions.name: withdraw_fees
functions.doc:
Sends `amount` of the treasury's accrued `token_id` fees to the treasury account. Only the
 treasury may call it, with exactly 1 yoctoNEAR (full-access key only). It can never take
 more than the fees accrued in that token, and touches no owner's balance. If the transfer
 fails (for example, the treasury is not registered with the token), the amount is credited
 back to the treasury's balance.

ExchangeLedger.description: The ledger entry of one token.

expected.description: What the vault's exchange account should hold of this token: every owner's `on_exchange`, plus whatever swaps in flight have sent to the exchange or received there.

generation.description: Bumped each time one of them starts. A reclaim checks it did not change between reading the exchange's balance and acting on it.

in_flight.description: Swaps and reclaims in flight that move this token into or out of that account.

Policy.description: Rules the contract enforces on every `agent_spend` and `agent_swap`. Only the vault owner can change them. A cleared policy (new vault, or after `remove_agent`) is empty and allows nothing.

allowlist.description: The only accounts the agent may send NEAR to.

VaultView.description: What `get_vault` returns: the vault's fields, plus its withdrawal lock.

agent_id.description: The only account allowed to call `agent_spend` and `agent_swap` for this vault.

balance.description: Spendable NEAR held for the owner.

frozen.description: While true, every `agent_spend` and `agent_swap` is rejected.

recent_spends.description: Agent spends and swaps from the last 24 hours, oldest first, including ones still in flight. Entries older than that stay until the next agent call prunes them.

tokens.description: One entry per token the vault has ever held for this owner.

withdrawals_locked_until.description: Block timestamp (ns) until which `withdraw` and `withdraw_token` are blocked; null if the owner never set a lock. A value in the past means the lock has expired.
